title: Ensemble node: node.yaml
description: One node: a worker that runs a helper team for its owner's agent sessions, from any folder, and, through a hub server, lends this computer's power. In ~/.config/ensemble/node.yaml, or a file of its own for each further node. Nothing has a default value; `team` and a block under `offers` that are left out are not used.

name.description: Its name, which a hub knows as <owner>/<name>: letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'.

access.description: private: it works for its owner alone. shared: also for everyone whose role has `compute`; connecting it needs `host`. A shared node offers only agents that run on llm_backends, never on an agent CLI's subscription.

team.description: The absolute directory of the helper team it runs, with its config.yaml. Sessions of `ensemble mcp` from any folder use it. Left out, the node runs no agents and only serves models.

offers.description: What it offers through a hub server. `{}` offers nothing.

runs.description: Agents of the node's team, which others name with an agent of `type: node`. A task gets a copy of the files git tracks, works in a folder of its own, and sends back what it changed.

agents.description: Which of the team's agents may run here.

models.description: Models an OpenAI-compatible server on this computer serves, reached through the hub at https://<hub>/nodes/v1 with an access token as the API key.

base_url.description: The server's OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable holding the server's API key, when it needs one.

timeout_seconds.description: The most one request may take.

names.description: The models offered, as the server names them.
